KEY METRICS AT A GLANCE (Dashboard Sheet)
? Compares AI displacement risk across all 7 industries.
A larger shaded area = higher overall risk in that sector.
? Shows each country's share of revenue growth.
Hover over slices for exact percentages.
? Displays average salary budget % change by company size.
Higher bars = more generous compensation growth.
? Tracks layoff volume by industry from 2024 to 2026.
Use the legend on the right to identify each industry line.
? Best viewed at 100% zoom on a 1080p or higher display.
? Use Excel 2016 or later for full slicer & chart support.

break the Pivot Tables and dashboard calculations.
